id.description: Unique identifier for an incentive win.

winnerFacebookFriendCount.description: The friend count of the winner's Facebook account, provided to help identify and disqualify fake profiles.

winnerLastRewardWonTitle.description: If this influencer has had one or more rewards fulfilled in the past, this gives the title of the reward most recently fulfilled.

winnerLastRewardFulfilledAt.description: If this influencer has had one or more rewards fulfilled in the past, this gives the date & time in which the most recent fulfillment occurred.

isDisqualified.description: Indicates whether this incentive winner has been disqualified.

disqualificationReason.description: If a incentive winner has been disqualified, this is the reason why the disqualification occurred.

rewardIsFulfilled.description: Indicates whether the reward win has been fulfilled. An incentive winner cannot be disqualified if his/her reward has already been fulfilled.
